teaching_language: This curriculum's own modules are largely English (5 INGLESE / 1 ITALIANO), but the degree's shared 'Comune a tutti i curricula' block (taken regardless of curriculum choice) is 6 INGLESE / 15 ITALIANO — so the degree is NOT 100% English end-to-end. Official presentation: "sono previsti 5 curricula di approfondimento dal titolo: ... Energy and Sustainability (in lingua inglese) - Theoretical Chemistry and Computational Modelling (in lingua inglese)." The other 3 curricula (Chimica Fisica, Chimica Inorganica per l'Energia e la Catalisi, Chimica Organica) are Italian-taught.
campus: Perugia (+ possible mobility to Jerusalem via the double-degree track, see notes)
department: DCBB — Dipartimento di Chimica, Biologia e Biotecnologie
places_available: Not published for this curriculum specifically.
academic_requirements: General Scienze chimiche LM-54 admission requirements apply (Italian laurea triennale in Chimica/Chemistry class L-27 or equivalent CFU distribution, assessed by the department); the Energy and Sustainability curriculum choice is made at enrolment. Full CFU breakdown not retrieved in this pass — recommend a dedicated check of the Regolamento didattico.
entry_exam_or_test: Not confirmed in this pass — likely curriculum/CV review as with other UNIPG open-access master's programmes. Needs dedicated verification.
nulla_osta_required: Not confirmed in this pass — recommend checking UNIPG's online nulla-osta list.
application_deadline_eu: EU/legally-residing applicants: PICA pre-enrolment from 1 July 2026 (no published closing date); SOL enrolment for open-access master closes 1 March 2027.
application_deadline_non_eu: Non-EU visa applicants: this programme was not explicitly named in the confirmed PICA groupings. It most likely falls under the general window, PICA call 2026-visa-03, open 29 May-7 June 2026, 12:00 — CLOSED as of research date (2026-09-05) — but this is an inference, not a confirmed programme-specific citation.
tuition_range: EUR 150-2,200/year via a 17-band ISEE table. Non-EU/foreign-income students use a fixed Flat Tax by home-country UNDP Human Development bracket (Turkey = HIGH HD = EUR 800/year + EUR 16 stamp) or ISEEU Parificato via an affiliated CAF. Declaration window 3 Aug-20 Oct 2026 (late to 1 Mar 2027; missing 28 Feb defaults to the maximum band, ~EUR 2,096).
cimea_requirement: Not specified at programme level; see university-wide study-documents page for CIMEA/blackout-date rules.
double_degree: Scienze chimiche (LM-54, M0103) has a double-degree agreement with Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel, built around an 'Environmental and Sustainable Chemistry' English curriculum, requiring at least one semester in Israel, with scholarships available. This is very likely the same track as this 'Energy and Sustainability' curriculum given the subject-matter overlap, but the exact 1:1 mapping between the two curriculum names ('Energy and Sustainability' at UNIPG vs 'Environmental and Sustainable Chemistry' at the double-degree level) has NOT been explicitly confirmed and needs dedicated verification with DCBB before publishing them as the same track.
